This measure summary covers the supplied records for SEP-B1 and READM-30.

For SEP-B1, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” the reported period is 2026-Q1. The measure unit is percent. The numerator is 115, the denominator is 535, and exclusions are 41. The reported rate is 23.28 percent. The event dates listed in the record are 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19. The available reference list includes a sepsis surveillance publication [F43].

For READM-30, “30-day all-cause readmission rate,” the reported period is 2026-Q2. The measure unit is percent. The numerator is 76, the denominator is 1033, and exclusions are 33. The reported rate is 7.6 percent. The event dates listed in the record are 2026-02-10, 2026-05-05, 2026-06-26, 2026-09-17, and 2026-12-02.

The supplied records provide measure identifiers, measure names, reporting periods, units, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, and event dates. They do not include stratified results, target thresholds, benchmark values, performance goals, or causal explanations. Accordingly, this summary reports the measure values as provided and does not characterize performance as meeting or missing a target.
